opportunities.situation: Bea asks whether you want to meet, and you also have project work to do. What should you do?

options.label: Spend two hours preparing project material.
options.success_text: I prepared a useful section of project material.

options.label: Spend two hours catching up with Bea.
options.contact_text: Alex and I caught up and talked about making time for each other.
options.success_text: Bea and I spent time together and talked about balancing work and friendship.
options.failure_text: We could not find time to talk.

contact_responses.label: Talk with Alex about balancing friendship and work.
contact_responses.success_text: Bea and I talked. Bea said that an earlier silence was due to being busy, not rejection of my work.
contact_responses.failure_text: Bea and I could not talk.
contact_responses.contact_text: I explained to Alex that being busy had caused my earlier silence.

contact_responses.label: Explain that you cannot talk now and suggest another time.
contact_responses.failure_text: Bea said talking was not possible now and suggested another day.
contact_responses.contact_text: I told Alex I could not talk now and suggested another day.

world_events.description: Alex receives payment for a completed task.

alex.text: I received five units of payment for an earlier completed task.
